en_title: Blade Director Says He Walked Away From Marvel's Canceled Movie Because 'Life's Too Short to Make S**t Films'
cn_title: 《刀锋战士》导演称，他退出漫威已取消的电影是因为「人生苦短，没时间拍烂片」
opus_summary: 导演Bassam Tariq谈及退出《漫威刀锋战士》的原因，称在没有完整剧本的情况下，他逐渐失去演员的信任，意识到自己必须完全掌控剧本。漫威影业于2019年宣布由马赫沙拉·阿里主演该片，影片最终被正式取消。

paragraphs.en: Director Bassam Tariq has opened up about why he exited Marvel's Blade movie, saying, "life's too short to make s**t films."
paragraphs.cn: 导演Bassam Tariq谈及了自己退出漫威电影《刀锋战士》的原因，称「人生苦短，没时间拍烂片」。

paragraphs.en: The Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother filmmaker explained his reasoning for walking away from the Mahershala Ali superhero period piece during an interview with The New Arab . With just one other feature film (Mogul Mowgli) under his belt at the time, working on Blade presented quite the opportunity, but his short time attached as the flick's first director wound up being more of a learning lesson than anything else.
paragraphs.cn: 这位《Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother》导演在接受The New Arab采访时，解释了自己退出这部由马赫沙拉·阿里主演的年代超级英雄电影的原因。当时他只拍过另一部长片《Mogul Mowgli》，执导《刀锋战士》是一次难得的机会，但他短暂担任这部电影首任导演的经历，最终更多地成为了一次教训。

paragraphs.en: "It was funny and strange to start casting and building without a proper script," Tariq said when asked what working in the studio system taught him. "You're sitting there and explaining to actors what their role will be, and they just have to believe you.
paragraphs.cn: 当被问及在制片厂体系中工作让他学到了什么时，Tariq说：「没有一份像样的剧本就开始选角和筹备，这很滑稽，也很奇怪。你坐在那里向演员解释他们的角色将会是什么样，而他们只能相信你。

paragraphs.en: "That's also very dangerous because if the text comes and it doesn't add up to what you were saying, your credibility gets completely shot. All I have is my integrity, and I've been thinking about that a lot."
paragraphs.cn: 「这也非常危险，因为如果剧本出来后和你所说的不一致，你的可信度就会彻底丧失。我拥有的只有自己的诚信，而我一直在反复思考这件事。」

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios announced an Ali-led Blade film in 2019 and picked Tariq to lead the charge in 2021. A little more than one year later, and the director was said to have bounced off the project , with Marvel telling The Hollywood Reporter that "shifts in our production schedule" were to blame.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业于2019年宣布将拍摄一部由阿里主演的《刀锋战士》电影，并于2021年选定Tariq执导。一年多后，据称这位导演退出了该项目，漫威向好莱坞报道者表示，原因是「我们的制作日程发生了变动」。

paragraphs.en: Today, one new director and multiple frustrated Ali updates later, and Blade has been finally, officially canceled . Marvel Cinematic Universe orchestrator Kevin Feige said the process made him feel like a "gigantic loser and failure" – an assessment Ali agreed with – but for Tariq, the decision to cut off his relationship with Blade came down to how it was impacting his relationship with the film's actors. He told The New Arab that being "the bearer of bad news to your actors" while a corporate entity makes all of the major decisions in the background is "not a great way to be a director."
paragraphs.cn: 如今，在更换了一位导演、阿里多次透露令人失望的进展之后，《刀锋战士》终于被正式取消。漫威电影宇宙的掌舵人凯文·费奇表示，这一过程让他觉得自己是「一个彻头彻尾的失败者」——阿里也认同这一评价——但对Tariq来说，他决定与《刀锋战士》断绝关系，归根结底是因为这件事对他与电影演员之间关系的影响。他告诉The New Arab，在一家企业实体于幕后做出所有重大决定的同时，自己却要「向演员传达坏消息」，这「不是当导演的好方式」。

paragraphs.en: "I know some people can take that and run with it, but I learned I was losing credibility with my actors, and it wasn't a healthy way to operate as a filmmaker. Life's too short to make s**t films, so that was my big lesson: I have to have full control over my script. If we disagree, it's between them and me. It's quite sad because we had such high hopes for what we wanted to build."
paragraphs.cn: 「我知道有些人能够接受这种情况并继续干下去，但我发现自己正在失去演员对我的信任，而这不是电影人开展工作的健康方式。人生苦短，没时间拍烂片，所以我得到的最大教训是：我必须完全掌控自己的剧本。如果我们有分歧，那也是他们和我之间的事。这很令人难过，因为我们曾对想要打造的东西寄予厚望。」

paragraphs.en: For now, as Marvel heads into another major release with next month's Avengers: Doomsday, there seems to be no sign of a live-action Blade for the MCU. Although the process of trying to get the movie out the door seems to have been tumultuous behind the scenes, there doesn't seem to be any bad blood from Tariq. In fact, when talking about how exiting the film made him feel like a failure last month, the director defended Feige, calling him a "good dude."
paragraphs.cn: 目前，漫威即将于下个月推出又一部重磅电影《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》，但漫威电影宇宙的真人版《刀锋战士》似乎仍没有任何动静。尽管幕后推动这部电影问世的过程似乎颇为波折，Tariq似乎并未心怀芥蒂。事实上，上个月这位导演谈到退出影片让他觉得自己像个失败者时，还为费奇说话，称他是个「好人」。

paragraphs.en: Although Ali's Blade never came to be, some of the effort put into the film did eventually see daylight. The actor went on to thank Marvel for the free year of physical training he got, which wound up helping him during the more intense scenes in Tariq's Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother. Costumes from Blade were also famously used in Ryan Coogler's Sinners .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管阿里主演的《刀锋战士》最终没能拍成，为这部电影付出的一些努力最终还是见了天日。这位演员后来感谢漫威让他免费接受了一年的体能训练，这最终帮助他完成了Tariq执导的《Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother》中一些更激烈的场面。众所周知，《刀锋战士》的服装也被用于瑞恩·库格勒执导的《罪人》。
